name: NEURA 4NE1
summary: 4NE1 is NEURA Robotics' full-size cognitive humanoid for industrial and collaborative work. NEURA lists it at 180 cm and 80 kg with a 10-20 kg payload, and takes reservations for the Gen 3.5 version at EUR 98,000. Shipping is planned for the end of 2026.
sensors: NEURA describes 360-degree perception and a sensor skin.

price.configuration: 4NE1 Gen 3.5, 1-19 units, excl. taxes and shipping (EUR 60,000 for 20+ units)

highlights: Refundable EUR 100 reservation fee credited toward the price.
Third generation premiered at Automatica 2025; smaller 4NE1 Mini shown at CES 2026.
NEURA raised a EUR 120 million Series B in January 2025.
caveats: Not yet shipping; availability is stated as end of 2026.
Total DoF and runtime are not on the official product page.
